description: List Rest Mode periods, which the user turns on when sick, injured or recovering, with start and end day (an ongoing period has no end) and the symptom tags logged during each. Use it to explain dips in readiness or activity, or to check whether the user was unwell on given days. Covers the last 90 days by default; set start and end (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) or days. A period that overlaps the range is included. Returns { records, next_token }; raw: true returns Oura's original objects.

days.description: The last N days up to end. Ignored when start is set.

end.description: Last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

raw.description: Return Oura's raw API objects instead of compact summaries with friendly units.

name: list_rest_mode_periods
title: List rest mode periods
